title: Sharpened Dynamical Cobordism
summary: We propose a sharpened version of Dynamical Cobordism, where the physical structure $ξ$ of the theory in question determines an allowed range $R^ξ$ for the critical exponent $δ$. We interpret a singularity with $δ\in R^ξ$ as a true transition-to-nothing, i.e., a configuration ending spacetime, while a singularity with $δ\notin R^ξ$ indicates some obstruction to such a transition, i.e., the presence of a non-trivial cobordism global charge, which is incompatible with a theory of quantum gravity.
